verdict.rationale: Pomelo's guides list a first-party capability to escalate fraud and dispute claims to the card networks, so disputes handling is part of the product. Nothing shows a programmatic API for it or any of the story's specific elements. The webhook evidence covers 3DS notifications, not disputes, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: documented dispute-filing API endpoints, network reason codes, evidence submission, provisional credit handling, dispute status webhooks through resolution, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can file and track disputes on card transactions programmatically — network reason codes, evidence submission, provisional credit handling, and status webhooks through resolution

citations.quote: Escala los reclamos por fraude y controversia con las marcas.
